comment: OpenIDX does not offer the address scope. It is not in scopes_supported, so the suite skips the module, as the certification profile allows for an optional scope.
OpenIDX does not offer the phone scope. It is not in scopes_supported, so the suite skips the module, as the certification profile allows for an optional scope.
The module asks for address and phone together with profile and email. OpenIDX offers neither of the first two, so the suite skips it.

OpenIDX does not support request objects: discovery says request_parameter_supported false and the authorization endpoints answer request_not_supported (#1006). The module then skips, which the certification profile allows for a server that rejects request objects.
